spans.s:
--a disciple of शौनक;
1: वा. ६१. ५३.
of कौशिकगोत्र.
2: Ib. ९१. ९९.
(I)--one of the two sons of Druhyu and father of Setu (Ripu-ब्र्। प्।) भा. IX. २३. १४; Br. III. ७४. 7; वा. ९९. 7; Vi. IV. १
(II)--a son of रोमपाद; (लोमपाद-ब्र्। प्।) and father of कृति. भा. IX. २४. 2; Br. III. ७०. ३८; Vi. IV. १२. ३९.
(III)--a disciple of शुनक (शौनक-ब्र्। प्।, वि। प्।) who taught him a सम्हिता. भा.

(IV)--a son of देववृध and गान्धिनी; the best among men; righteous and truthful; a महारथ of the सात्वतस्; through his precept and that of his father, several thousands attained immortality;
1: भा. IX. २४. 9-११; वा. ९६. १५; Vi. IV. १

, १०७; M. ४४. ५६-60.
performed sacrifices and lavished gifts; got the jewel Syamantaka and gave it to कृष्ण, to be returned by the latter.
2: Br. III. ७१. १३, ८१-2, ९६ and ९८.
--the author of a कामशास्त्र; see सुबालक. M. २१. ३०; १९८. 4.
